note: H7 as originally defined ('backward sensitivity 10-30× larger than forward') is FALSIFIED. The actual backward ratio (~4×) is comparable to or smaller than forward ratio (3-15×) when measured without thermal throttling.

H7_A.title: Actual backward work quantity differs significantly
H7_A.conclusion: tile16 has exactly 4.00× more tile-Gaussian intersections than tile32. This is determined purely by tile geometry (8160 tiles / 2040 tiles = 4).
H7_A.evidence_summary: All 6 checkpoints show precise 4.00× intersection ratio. tpg_median = total_tiles (100% tile occupancy).

H7_B.title: Same work magnitude but tile16 per-unit work is less efficient
H7_B.conclusion: Per-intersection efficiency is similar between tile16 (0.21-0.35 μs/isect) and tile32 (0.20-0.34 μs/isect). Efficiency ratio fluctuates around 1.0× (within measurement noise).
H7_B.evidence_summary: Normalized timing on cold GPU. Per-checkpoint μs/isect comparison shows no significant efficiency difference.

H7_C.title: Tile16-specific backward code path
H7_C.conclusion: Same compiled binary, same 4 backward kernels, same launch sequence. Only grid/block dimensions differ for kernel 1.
H7_C.evidence_summary: Full source trace of all 4 backward kernels. cuobjdump VERIFIED identical binary.

H7_D.title: Nonlinear growth from tile-Gaussian intersections
H7_D.conclusion: t16 backward scales near-linearly with work: 1.07× time increase for 1.21× intersection increase.

H7_E.title: Memory / atomic contention
H7_E.conclusion: Cannot directly measure. Nsight Compute unavailable on WDDM RTX 5070 laptop.
H7_E.evidence_summary: Source code shows 10 gpuAtomicAdd calls per valid Gaussian-pixel pair. Hardware counter evidence is BLOCKED.

H7_F.title: Timing artifact / synchronization issue
H7_F.conclusion: Phase 8B's 137-234× ratio is NOT reproducible. Fresh cold-GPU measurement yields 2.6-6.3×. The extreme ratio is caused by GPU thermal throttling.
H7_F.predictive_power: EXPLANATORY — explains the discrepancy between Phase 8B and Phase 8C results
H7_F.evidence_summary: Phase 8B raw samples show clear bimodal distribution (alternating ~875ms and ~2528ms). Phase 8C cold GPU reproduces with 3-6× ratio. nvidia-smi shows GPU temperature/power consistent with throttling.
